why.why: Why swap at 2 echoes instead of 3? Windfury's extra swing can waste an echo. When short on mana, waiting for 3 is worth it.
Why swap at 2 echoes instead of 3? Windfury's extra swing can waste an echo.
Why wait for 3 echoes? Fewer seal casts leave more mana for Exorcism.
Why 45 Energy? Predatory Discipline keeps the Energy above 35, and it still adds damage.
Why at 60 Energy or less, even with a Bite due? Its 40 Energy won't cap, and with an 8 sec cooldown any delay loses Energy.
Why wait for a Frostbolt in flight? Both then hit while the boss counts as Frozen.
Why recast with 6 sec left? So Frigid Power's 15% never drops.

why.when: More than an Arcane Wrath cast
why.why: Why Arcane Wrath? Four Arcane Blast stacks no longer use up your mana, so it spends the rest.
Why Presence of Mind on Arcane Wrath? It's the longest cast.

why.when: under 0.2s since the last ranged swing
why.why: Why wait after the Auto Shot? Moving cancels its windup. The 0.2 sec is a player's reaction: less is worth a few DPS, but faster than anyone plays.

why.when: ready by the time you reach melee
why.why: Why the mana check? Raptor Strike costs mana: weaving wins short fights but runs long ones dry.

why.when: ready by the time you reach melee
why.why: Why wait for Arcane Shot and Multi-Shot to be on cooldown? No shot goes out from melee, so walking in then would hold one back.
Why drop Sniper Shot first when mana runs short? It does the least damage per mana.
Why below Arcane Shot and Multi-Shot? So refreshing it never delays them.
Why last? So refreshing it never delays a shot with a cooldown.
Why Multi-Shot under Aimed Shot? They share a cooldown. When Aimed Shot's cast would cut into a weave, the instant Multi-Shot takes it.
Why Rapid Fire as a melee hunter? Under Forever it speeds up melee attacks too.
Why Hunter's Mark on a melee hunter? Expose Prey opens Mongoose Bite only on a marked target.
Why the trap ahead of Raptor Strike and Lacerate? Under Forever, fire traps scale with ranged attack power.
Why Wing Clip? Each hit can proc Windfury Totem, which is over half of its worth (about 65 DPS).
Why this totem when it does nothing for you? It's for your party's melee.
Why Magma Totem on one target? From melee range its pulse reaches the boss, for about twice Searing Totem's damage.
Why keep 12 mana per second left? So the mana runs out just as the fight ends, whatever its length.
Why not with Flame Shock about to drop? They share the shock cooldown, so it would still be on cooldown when Flame Shock runs out.
Why a shock at the very end? A Lightning Bolt cast then lands too late: it flies about 1 sec.
Why rank 8? It's the lowest rank that keeps its full spell power coefficient at 60. Rank 7 keeps only 75%.
Why Conflagrate on cooldown? With Shadow and Flame it no longer consumes Immolate, and each hit gives 10% more Shadow damage for 20 sec.
Why recast Immolate with as little as 4 sec left? Incinerate needs it for its 25%, and Conflagrate needs it to hit.
Why on Mind Blast? Inner Focus's crit doesn't apply to Shadow Word: Death or damage over time.
Why wait for 10% mana? Most fights end first, and its global cooldown goes on damage instead.
Why only above 40% mana? In a long fight the recasts run the priest short of mana.
Why only above 80% mana? Otherwise it spends the mana Smite needs.
Why not on cooldown? Without Shadowform it costs full mana, which Smite uses better. At the very end the mana no longer matters.
Why rank 7? It's the lowest rank Forever's downranking penalty spares: it keeps its full spell power share at level 60.
Why wait for 5 Scorch stacks? Until then the Scorches are capped by the global cooldown, so the haste buys nothing.
Why Fire Blast on cooldown? Each one adds a Heating Up stack, two on a crit, toward a faster Pyroblast.
Why Fire Blast at all? Each one adds a Heating Up stack, two on a crit, toward a faster Pyroblast.
Why only the last charge? The first goes on a Frostfire Bolt, which the charge makes a Shatter crit.
Why only once Evocation is spent? Until then the mana comes back, so the full rank is still affordable.
Why before the Arcane Blasts? The next Arcane Blast can roll a new Missile Barrage proc over this one, and a free cast is lost.
Why Frostbolt in an Arcane build? Without a Missile Barrage proc it beats Arcane Missiles.
Why Wrath at 2 charges, not 0? A Starfire begun while the Wrath flies gets no cut, so keep charges for it. At 3, the Wrath's 2 would pass the cap of 4.
Why Rip at 4 combo points? Rip's attack power share stops growing at 4, so the fifth point adds less than the ticks lost waiting for it.
Why save Death Wish for the end? It then covers the execute phase, where Execute spends all your Rage.
Why wait for so much Rage? Forever's white hits give the same Rage at 60 as at 30, so Heroic Strike only gets Rage the main strikes won't need.
Why Hamstring? Each hit can proc Windfury Totem, which more than pays for the 10 Rage.
Why 4 combo points? Puncturing Wounds gives Backstab a 45% chance at a second point, so waiting for a fifth often wastes one.
Why 4 combo points? Backstab often gives 2, from Puncturing Wounds or a Seal Fate crit, so waiting for a fifth often wastes one.
Why 4 combo points when Combat Swords waits for 5? Seal Fate gives a crit a second point, so waiting for a fifth often wastes one.
Why 4 combo points? Mutilate gives 2 at a time and often lands on 4, so waiting for a fifth wastes points.
Why hold it while Vanish is ready? To keep 60 Energy for the Ambush.
Why hold it while Vanish is ready? To keep 60 Energy for the Ambush.

_doc_why: Why a preset's line is the way it is, shown under the line on the Rotation card: builds (a duty or encounter preset takes its base build's), the line's key, a part of its condition where a build has more than one line with that key, and the text. Keep it short and say only what isn't obvious, as a question and its answer ("Why swap at 2 echoes instead of 3? ..."); the card then shows no "Why:" label.
